seo.title: Madrid Transport Map - Metro, Cercanías & Fare Zones
seo.description: Interactive transit network and CRTM fare zones map for Madrid. Explore Metro, Cercanías, EMT, Interurban buses and tariff zones A through E2.
seo.keywords: Madrid transport map, Metro Madrid, Cercanias Renfe, EMT Madrid, CRTM zones, abono transporte, fare zones

a.name: Zone A
a.coverage: Madrid capital central municipality (Sol, Atocha, Chamartín, Barajas, Vallecas, Carabanchel)

b1.name: Zone B1
b1.coverage: First metropolitan crown (Alcobendas, San Sebastián de los Reyes, Pozuelo, Majadahonda, Coslada, San Fernando, Getafe, Leganés, Alcorcón)

b2.name: Zone B2
b2.coverage: Second metropolitan crown (Las Rozas, Móstoles, Fuenlabrada, Parla, Pinto, Rivas-Vaciamadrid, Torrejón de Ardoz, Tres Cantos)

b3.name: Zone B3
b3.coverage: Third metropolitan ring (Alcalá de Henares, Colmenar Viejo, Collado Villalba, Valdemoro, Navalcarnero, Arganda del Rey, Arroyomolinos)

c1.name: Zone C1
c1.coverage: Outer metropolitan region (Aranjuez, El Escorial, Guadarrama, Chinchón, San Martín de Valdeiglesias, Buitrago del Lozoya)

c2.name: Zone C2
c2.coverage: Border municipalities of Community of Madrid (Cercedilla, Santa María de la Alameda, Puebla de la Sierra)

e1.name: Zone E1
e1.coverage: Castilla-La Mancha adjacent corridor (Guadalajara, Azuqueca de Henares, Illescas)

e2.name: Zone E2
e2.coverage: Castilla-La Mancha extended corridor (Talavera de la Reina, Toledo capital, Tarancón)
